newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Erste confirms leaves Creditanstalt bid group.
newsitem.headline: Erste confirms leaves Creditanstalt bid group.

text.p: Austrian savings bank Die Erste on Friday confirmed it had left an Austro-German-Italian group of bidders for privatisation candidate Creditanstalt-Bankverein.

"Die Erste regrets that no agreement could be found with the consortium partners after all. It was surprising that the other partners in the consortium have ended the negotiations even though substantial progress had been made," it said in a statement.

The consortium of bidders for the government's 70 percent voting stake in Creditanstalt, led by Austro-Italian insurer EA-Generali has been at odds over Die Erste's proposal to form a holding with Creditanstalt, which it would control.
The Austrian government had given the group, so far the only known bidder for the flagship bank, until midnight Friday to come up with a final offer. -- Knut Engelmann, Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
